`kernel-checked` is a receipt label written only by a trusted --run-lean execution (formal/.lake/formal-evidence/receipt.json) after fresh build, leanchecker, transitive #print axioms audit restricted to propext / Classical.choice / Quot.sound, elaborated-type capture and every negative control actually failing (7 tightened/wrong statements + sorry + indirect custom axiom + native_decide); a caller-supplied receipt is untrusted until matched to the actual workflow run and commit. Parent dependencies not formalised are explicit hypotheses of the target, never axioms
Core Lean has no rationals: state rational identities as cross-multiplied integers, give the rational form in the docstring, put the exact 'not established' boundary per target in formal/SCOPE.md

Statement alignment is its own review: AI- or human-authored Lean text is author-side until a reviewer with a different provider, family and agent records an alignment (Markdown + JSON under formal/reviews/, validated with --alignment; record carries disposition ACCEPTED, manifest_sha256, scope_sha256, exactly all targets, author/reviewer provider/family/agent, evidence repo/path/40-char commit/sha256); same-provider reviewers earn zero independence credit; a fresh source, scope, toolchain or manifest digest stales the old review (formal/REVIEW_LANE.md, formal/SCOPE.md)

Formal evidence never moves Layer 0 status: a kernel-checked target does not edit STATUS.md, PROOF_INDEX.md, LANDING_CLAIMS, claims/, prizes, lemma_closed or any ACCEPT/AMEND row and does not make the surrounding analytic argument verified; formal/GLOSSARY.md mappings are descriptive/proposed; formal-progress labels none/specified/proved/kernel-checked are not scientific labels; ladder L0 prose ...
